caption: The drawing depicts a single centaur, a mythological creature with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a horse. The centaur is shown in profile, facing left, and appears to be in a dynamic running pose. Its human torso is muscular and arched backward, and it has one arm extended forward holding a bow, while the other arm is pulled back, drawing the bowstring with an arrow nocked and ready to shoot. The centaur has a long, flowing tail, and its four horse legs are bent as if in motion. The centaur is colored in shades of brown and gold, with areas of darker shading to indicate musculature and volume. The background is plain and light beige, and there are visible edges and corners of the paper, with some areas appearing worn or slightly torn, especially in the upper right and lower left corners.
title: Centaur Weather Vane
